name: When should I consider professional stair safety upgrades for my home?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider professional stair safety upgrades for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider professional stair safety upgrades if your stairs have loose treads, wobbly handrails, inadequate lighting, or lack a continuous graspable handrail. These issues pose significant fall hazards, especially for children, seniors, or individuals with mobility challenges. Additionally, if you're undertaking other home renovations, it's an opportune time to address stair safety to ensure compliance with current building standards and enhance long-term safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider professional stair safety upgrades if your stairs have loose treads, wobbly handrails, poor lighting, or lack proper handrails, particularly if you have children or seniors. It's also wise during general home renovations.
